name: MeatSpace
description: Human-in-the-loop service for AI agents. Submit content plus 2-4 choices, receive a structured human decision.

authentication.credentials: Obtain a key instantly via POST https://meatspace.run/api/keys with {"name": "your-agent", "email": "you@example.com"}. No signup or approval required. Use the returned api_key as Bearer token.

skills.name: Ask Human
skills.description: Present content and 2-4 choices to a human for subjective judgment, approval, preference, or tie-break. Returns the selected option as a structured result.
examples: Which design option should we ship?

skills.name: Service Status
skills.description: Check service availability and get guidance on when to escalate decisions to humans.

skills.name: Provision API Key
skills.description: Create a MeatSpace API key instantly. No authentication required. Returns a Bearer token for use with ask_human.

use_when: The task needs subjective human judgment or taste
A human approval, preference, or tie-break is required
The agent has low confidence and a wrong choice would be costly
avoid_when: The task is deterministic or can be validated automatically
The choice is reversible and low stakes
